name: Santa Anna Mexican Food
notes: No website on file; business has no first-party ordering site found. DoorDash marketplace listing (name on DoorDash is 'Santa Ana Fresh Mexican Food', address 4909 El Cajon Boulevard, San Diego CA - matches work-list address exactly) is the best reachable source, read from server-side schema.org JSON-LD. Passed the markup test (dividing all 91 raw items by 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25/1.30 gave no divisor above 17.6% clean, well below the near-100% signature of a true markup) so prices are used as-is. Deduped a 'Most Ordered' promo section against the categorized sections (12 of 12 items were exact repeats except 2 drinks, which were kept and re-labeled 'Drinks & Highlights'). Sections reached: Tortas, Breakfast Tortas, Burritos, Breakfast Burritos, Fries & Chips, Quesadillas, Tacos, Seafood, Combination Plate, plus the 2 drinks. Combination Plate only exposed 3 numbered items (#14, #19, #21) - the full numbered combo list is likely longer than what DoorDash carries, so that section may be a partial slice; every other section reads complete. Uber Eats and Yelp both required a browser session (404/JS) and were not used.
